title: Safer hand: the familiar end, at full craft
question: Safer register: three conventional directions from the GDG world, plus the category standard. You pick.

options.label: Expressive Google-native Product
options.lineage: Google's expressive product language (I/O and Android sites)
options.thesis: A polished product site that feels native to the Google developer world: bold rounded type, playful shape cut-outs and GDG colour roles around a live code.
materials: large soft shapes in GDG colours (our own, not Google's)
options.viewport: A big headline at left; at right the live code sits inside a large blue rounded shape while smaller red, yellow and green shapes orbit and morph as the payload cycles; Open Studio as a pill button.
options.risk: Reads as a Material template or Google imitation if the shapes and type are not our own.

options.label: Codelab Docs
options.thesis: QR Studio taught like a codelab: numbered steps with durations, real payload code blocks, and 'What you'll build' at the top.
options.viewport: A docs-style page: a step rail at left, the headline 'What you'll build' with the live code, and step 1 already interactive.
options.risk: Very credible to GDG members but the least playful; can read as documentation, not a product.

options.label: Dev Sticker Sheet
options.lineage: die-cut laptop stickers and event swag
options.thesis: A clean, modern product site whose identity is a sheet of die-cut stickers: every QR type is a sticker you can peel off and stick on a poster.
materials: die-cut stickers with white borders and soft shadows
options.viewport: The headline over a laptop lid scattered with stickers; the hero sticker is the live QR code, peeling at one corner as the payload cycles; Open Studio as a sticker-shaped button.
options.risk: Sticker swag is a common dev-tool look; can tip juvenile if it spreads into the studio.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A product-grade QR generator landing page, executed at the craft of Linear or Vercel and positioned against QRCode Monkey and QR Code Generator Pro.
canonCard.viewport: Headline and CTA at left, the live studio preview at right, then features, the scan-reliability demo and FAQ.
canonCard.risk: Well made but visually interchangeable with competitors.
